digest.component_or_area: live external integration test suite for Jira Data Center multi-project scenarios
propositions: Live Cloud rehearsal against two shared production projects (REB, DIG) cannot model three repo shapes, empty projects, and unknown-project fail-closed paths, and masks real Jira parse-errors on non-existent project keys that abort the entire pass due to missing per-project exception handling in the inbound fetcher.

An isolated ephemeral Jira DC instance with admin rights allows creating and destroying scratch projects per test run, enabling reproducible CI-verified scenarios including real empty projects and genuine unknown-project fail-closed behavior without contaminating production data.

Preview-gated mutations enforce cross-project isolation: each mutating scenario must run `bridge preview` first and verify the planned mutation set contains only targets in the intended project before `bridge sync` executes.

Session-scoped scratch project provisioning using hardened templates with verified capabilities ensures four projects model distinct repo configurations (one/two/zero repos and legacy default), with cleanup on all exit paths including mid-run failures.
